Ruijie RG-POE-AT30 Single Port Gigabit PoE Power Adapter – IEEE 802.3at Compliant

Boost Your Network with Reliable Power & Data Transmission

The Ruijie RG-POE-AT30 is a professional-grade PoE injector engineered for high-reliability and performance in enterprise and commercial networks. Offering up to 30W of PoE power and full Gigabit data throughput, this unit is perfect for powering high-demand PoE devices such as HD IP cameras, ceiling-mounted Wi-Fi access points, and VoIP desk phones.

Technical Features:

  • Standard Compliance: IEEE 802.3af (15.4W) / 802.3at (30W)
  • Power Supply Input: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz
  • Output Power: 55V DC, 30W max
  • Ethernet Support: 10/100/1000 Mbps (Auto-sensing)
  • Connector Type: RJ-45 x 2 (Data In, Data + Power Out)
  • Dimensions: Compact desktop unit
  • Mounting Options: Wall-mountable or desktop use
  • Built-in Protection: OVP, OCP, SCP (over-voltage, over-current, short-circuit)

Ideal for use in:

  • Surveillance systems
  • SMB networking environments
  • Campus and enterprise Wi-Fi deployments
